description:
How to mint a SHORT-LIVED, minimally-scoped provider API key for cloud_provision/
    cloud_destroy, hand it over by PATH (api_key_file=<path>, never inline in chat), and
    DELETE/rotate it the moment the server exists. Sibling of cloudflare_token_instructions,
    for the VPS provider the user uses (pass `provider` - whatever they told you). DO NOT list
    or advertise which providers the auto-create shortcut supports.
name: cloud_key_instructions
